Home / About Us

Well-being begins with a place that works.

Mai'Lafiya means well-being. For 17 years we have helped Northern Nigeria's businesses and families find property that genuinely works for them.

Our story

From a Bompai family shop to Northern Nigeria's trusted name.

Mai'Lafiya began in 2008 as a small family trading business in Bompai, Kano. Helping neighbours and suppliers find reliable warehouse space taught us that in Northern Nigeria, property is built on relationships and reputation.

Today we are a registered real-estate, property-management and construction-consulting firm serving six cities, with 340+ transactions and ₦12B+ in deals closed — and we still walk every property ourselves.

A Word From Our Founder
“When you trust us with a property, you are trusting us with your family's or your company's future. We never forget that.”

Mr. Kingsley Agena · Founder & Chief Executive

Our values

What we hold ourselves to

Amana (Trust)

We hold client funds, documents and confidences as a sacred trust — and we have never given anyone a reason to doubt it.

Adalci (Fairness)

Transparent fees, honest valuations, and the same straight answer whether the deal is ₦3 million or ₦3 billion.

Sabuntawa (Renewal)

We keep improving how we inspect, price and manage property so every client gets better service than the last.

Al’umma (Community)

Real estate is how families and businesses grow. We invest in the communities where we work across the North.
